description: Returns everything about one ticker or a comma list of up to 50 in the path (a screen's matches, say): every signal each one carries, live or on any past date with `asof`. A comma list returns `data` keyed by symbol plus `not_found`. Crypto is the X-prefixed pair (X:BTCUSD); bare BTC/ETH are US-listed ETFs.

asof.description: Target moment as `YYYY-MM-DD` (that day's close) or an ISO timestamp (that intraday moment; daily-only signals then carry the previous session's close, never that day's): the same read as it stood then, unlimited depth. Full contract under As of a past date.

grain.description: Only with `asof`. Grain the past state is read at: `1m`, `1h`, `1d` or `auto` (default). `auto` blends: each signal comes from its freshest grain at or before the instant (minute, then hourly, then the last closed daily session), so nothing is refused for grain and no ticker is dropped; `_meta.blended` and `_meta.grains_present` say what contributed. Pin a grain for the fastest response: one grain is read instead of three. A signal in `select` that the pinned grain does not store is a `400 interval_unavailable` naming the grains that carry it (`rsi_14`, fundamentals and valuation ratios are `1d`-only). Without `select`, the row carries the signals the pinned grain stores, and `_meta.signals_not_stored_at_grain` names the rest. A grain with no data for the ticker within its window (14 days for `1d`, 5 for `1h`/`1m`) is a `404 interval_unavailable`. `1m` and `1h` need a timestamp `asof`; with a bare date they are a `400 interval_unavailable`. A live read with `grain` is a 400.

select.description: Comma-separated signals to return: each row is `ticker` plus exactly these. Omit it, or send `*`, for the full row: every signal the ticker carries, or on an as-of read every signal the read's grain stores. An unknown signal is a 400, beside `*` too.

ticker.description: One symbol, or a comma-separated list of up to 50 for a response keyed by symbol. Case-insensitive. Equities are bare symbols (`NVDA`); every other class carries a prefix: rates (`R:SOFR`), crypto (`X:BTCUSD`), fx (`X:EURUSD`). Bare `BTC`/`ETH` are US-listed ETFs, not spot crypto. See Tickers.

name: tickerbot_get_ticker
